name: kneeling wrist rocks
description: On hands and knees you rock your shoulders forward and back over flat palms. It eases the wrists into the bent-back position used in push-ups and handstands.
instructions: Kneel on all fours with your hands under your shoulders and fingers pointing forward.
Spread your fingers wide and press the whole palm into the floor.
Keep your arms straight and slowly shift your shoulders forward past your hands.
Rock back until your shoulders are over or behind your wrists.
Keep the heels of your hands down the whole time and move in a pain-free range.
